title: The 20-letter test string
bestSource: Benchmark string of Unger and Moult (1993). Optimum found by exhaustive search (scripts/hp-optimum.ts).
intro: The first of the standard test strings for folding algorithms (Unger and Moult, 1993). Its best fold has 9 contacts.
hint: Find a compact block for the ten H’s first; the P’s go on its boundary.
